display.purpose: Hero statements on landing and marketing surfaces.

body.purpose: Dashboard text at 14px; marketing pages scale up.

label.purpose: Any measured value: prices, amounts, timestamps, limits, IDs.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Signature hero surfaces only; never a resting card state.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation ships with a reduced-motion off-switch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one inviting action on any screen: Signal Blue fill, Void Black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--primary, #4388ff); color: var(--primary-foreground, #02040a); border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(67,136,255,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67,136,255,0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent, hairline border, quiet hover fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #e7edff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #223052); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #172239); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67,136,255,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Instrument surface: Console Slate, hairline border, xl radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #111a2d); color: var(--card-foreground, #f4f7ff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #223052); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground, #8fa3c4); } .ds-card-value { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Field: transparent on dark, Deep Grid stroke, Signal Blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #e7edff); border: 1px solid var(--input, #223052); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67,136,255,0.4); border-color: var(--ring, #4388ff); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #8fa3c4); }

components.name: Cosmic Card
components.description: Signature panel: gradient edge light on a bordered card, used on branding surfaces.
components.css: .ds-cosmic-card { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.045), rgba(3,7,18,0.5)), var(--card, #111a2d); color: var(--card-foreground, #f4f7ff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #223052); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-cosmic-card::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(96,165,250,0.55), transparent); }

narrative.overview: The product is a dome at night: the universe (stars, nebulae, comet trails) is decoration that lives far away on established background layers, while everything the visitor reads is a calm, precise instrument. Density is functional: trading dashboards reward numbers that sit still. Interfaces are dark-only; depth comes from surface tone, almost never from shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only palette of navy decks with a single blue accent and cool cyan highlight
Tonal elevation: #070b16 page, #0b1122 shell, #111a2d card; borders carry separation
Geist sans for reading, Geist Mono for anything that measures a value
Motion is rare, short (200-320ms), and always reduced-motion-capped

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only accent that acts. Aurora Cyan lights, Nebula Violet decorates — neither may invite a click.

rules.name: The Star Budget Rule
rules.body: Star fields, nebulae, and grid backgrounds belong to atmosphere utilities (.cosmic-stars, .nebula-atmosphere, .bg-grid); raw fills per screen stay inside those utilities.

rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule
rules.body: Anything measured — balances, drawdowns, payout amounts, dates in tables — renders in Geist Mono, never in the sans.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: At rest, surfaces separate by tone and border. Shadows appear on interaction or on the few signature hero surfaces.

dos: Do resolve every surface color through tokens (bg-background, bg-card, border-border); new shades go into :root first.
Do render numeric values in Geist Mono with tabular alignment.
Do wrap any wide table (min-w-[...]) in overflow-x-auto.
donts: Don't hardcode hex against the token set (known offenders are being migrated to tokens; do not add new ones).
Don't introduce a light theme or per-component color-scheme exceptions.
Don't animate layout properties or leave motion without a prefers-reduced-motion off-switch.
